title: Pure Yang Zing
summary: Pure Yang Zing Wyrm Synchro strategy, commanding the legendary Chinese dragons of the Duel Terminal world that float into new Wyrm bodies from the Deck whenever destroyed. By synchronizing during the opponent's turn and conferring permanent immunities and ATK boosts, the deck builds untouchable celestial bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Jiaotu, Darkness of the Yang Zing sends two Yang Zing cards from hand to GY while you control no other monsters to Special Summon two Yang Zing monsters (one with 0 ATK and one with 0 DEF) directly from your Deck.
Chiwen, Light of the Yang Zing is a Level 1 Tuner that Special Summons a Yang Zing from Deck when destroyed, and revives itself from GY when a Yang Zing on field is destroyed.

Denglong, First of the Yang Zing adds any Yang Zing card from Deck to hand upon Synchro Summon, sends a Wyrm from Deck to GY to match its Level, and Special Summons a Yang Zing from Deck when it leaves the field.
All Level 1 through 5 non-Tuner Yang Zings (Bi'an, Bixi, Pulao, Suanni, Taotie) Special Summon a Yang Zing monster from Deck in Defense Position when destroyed by battle or card effect.

summary.title: Opening: Jiaotu Synchro Climb
steps: Normal Summon Jiaotu, Darkness of the Yang Zing while controlling no other monsters.
Activate Jiaotu's effect, sending two Yang Zing cards from hand to GY to Special Summon Suanni, Fire of the Yang Zing and Bi'an, Earth of the Yang Zing from your Deck.
Synchro Summon Denglong, First of the Yang Zing using Jiaotu and Bi'an; Denglong searches Nine Pillars of Yang Zing from your Deck.
Activate Denglong's effect, sending Chiwen, Light of the Yang Zing from Deck to GY to modulate Denglong's Level to 1.
Synchro Summon Baxia, Brightness of the Yang Zing using Denglong and Suanni; Suanni grants Baxia +500 ATK/DEF, and Denglong floats into a Yang Zing from Deck.
Baxia triggers on summon to shuffle cards the opponent controls back into the Deck up to the number of different original Attributes among materials (shuffling 2).
Set Nine Pillars of Yang Zing and pass, ready to negate any activation and trigger further floating.

summary.title: Inherited Blessings & Accel Synchro
points: Yang Zing non-Tuners can Synchro Summon as a Quick Effect during the opponent's Main Phase or Battle Phase.
Bi'an makes the summoned Synchro Monster completely indestructible by battle.
Bixi makes the summoned Synchro Monster completely unaffected by Trap effects.
Pulao makes the summoned Synchro Monster completely unaffected by Spell effects.
Suanni gives the summoned Synchro Monster +500 ATK and DEF permanently.
Taotie prevents control of the summoned Synchro Monster from switching.

summary.title: Bosses & Spells
points: Baxia, Brightness of the Yang Zing spins opponent cards into the Deck on summon and destroys 1 card you control once per turn to revive a Level 4 or lower monster from your GY.
Chaofeng, Phantom of the Yang Zing completely prevents the opponent from activating monster effects with the same original Attributes as the Yang Zing monsters used for its Synchro Summon.

Yazi, Evil of the Yang Zing cannot be targeted by opponent card effects, destroys 1 Yang Zing you control and 1 card the opponent controls, and Special Summons any Wyrm monster from your Deck when destroyed.
Nine Pillars of Yang Zing is an omni-negating Counter Trap that shuffles the negated card into the Deck and destroys 1 other Yang Zing card you control.
Yang Zing Creation Special Summons a Yang Zing monster from your Deck whenever a monster you control is destroyed by battle or card effect.
Yang Zing Path targets 3 Yang Zing monsters in your GY, shuffles them into the Deck, and draws 2 cards.
